reroute_reason.fix: np2 (S-NORM 2026-10-15): measured np1 cause = LATE CAPTURE ROOT: one clock root over 5,890 sinks along 426 um (depth 6-7, FF boundary arrival 264-328 ps vs the median pin-flop hold reference); the late quarter of capture flops needs ~37 ps more input hold than repair (margin 10) left, routed FF -12.44 i2r, ECO pads failed. Fix: (1) clock split into 4 equal-count x clusters, one BUFx24 local root each (clock_split.tcl), (2) hold pads HB4xp67 (common_flow/hold_pad_hb4.tcl, 2.4x delay/cell vs BUFx2) so (3) the recipe-2 hold margin 30 ps is affordable again (np1 ran 10). Same RTL, cycles, pins, SDC, acceptance.
